message.content:
To **log in to OneDrive**, go to the OneDrive sign-in page and enter your Microsoft account email address, then your password.[1][7][10]

If you want to use the **web version**, Microsoft says you can sign in directly to OneDrive in your browser or through Microsoft 365’s app launcher.[6] If you want the **desktop app** on Windows, search for OneDrive from the Start menu or taskbar, open it, and sign in when prompted.[6]

If you need, I can also give you the exact steps for:
- **personal OneDrive**
- **work/school OneDrive**
- **Windows app**
- **iPhone/Android**
